title: CPSC, J.C. Penney Corp. Announce Recall of Infant and Toddler Sweaters
summary: The zipper-pull mechanism can detach from the zipper, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: 57,000 (42,000 toddler-size and 15,000 infant size).

title: CPSC, The Elegant Kids 2000 Inc. Announce Recall of Pacifiers
summary: The pacifiers are banned under federal law. They failed federal safety tests, when the nipples separated from the base, and can pose a choking hazard to infants and small children. Units: About 34,500.

title: CPSC and QSP, Inc., Announce Recall of Flying Saucer Toys
summary: The Flying Saucer can overheat while charging, resulting in the plastic motor cover starting to melt, creating a risk of burns to children handling the toy. Units: 555.

title: CPSC, Hirschberg Schutz & Co. Inc. Announce Recall of Metal Charms
summary: The recalled metal charms contain high levels of lead, posing a serious risk of lead poisoning to young children. Lead poisoning in children is associated with behavioral problems, learning disabilities, hearing problems and growth retardation. Units: About 2.8 million.

title: CPSC, Ocean Desert Sales Inc. Announce Recall of Children's Stuffed Yarn Bunnies
summary: The eyes can detach from the stuffed animal, posing an aspiration hazard to young children. Additionally, the heart and flower button decorations also can detach, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 18,500.

title: CPSC, Ginger® Announce Recall of Bathroom Light Fixtures
summary: The glass shades can separate from the light fixture, posing a risk that a consumer could be cut by the broken glass if the shade were to fall and break. Units: About 5,900.

title: CPSC, Lands' End Announce Recall of Zipper Pulls on Children's Outer Wear
summary: The rubber zipper pull-tab can be bitten off and may pose a risk of choking to young children. Units: About 24,000.

title: CPSC, American Suzuki Motor Corporation Announce Recall of 2004-2005 Vinson and 2005 KingQuad All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs)
summary: Water can enter the throttle lever case and freeze, causing the throttle lever to become stuck and fail to automatically return to the idle position when the rider releases the throttle. title: CPSC, Kawasaki Motors Corp. U.S.A. Announce Recall of Kawasaki Prairie™ 700 ATVs
summary: The age recommendation warning label is missing. Children under 16 years old riding these adult-size ATVs can suffer serious injury or death. Units: About 1,140.

title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Announce Recall of "900 Fusion," "900 RMK" and "900 Switchback" Snowmobiles
summary: The snowmobile wiring harness may be routed in a way that could disconnect the engine stop switch and the throttle safety switch connector. If this connector becomes unplugged, the engine stop and the throttle safety switches will no longer function. This could pose a possible crash hazard. However,

title: CPSC, Skylighter Inc. Announce Recall of Musical Flower Birthday Candleholders
summary: The center of the candle has an unexpected high flame and the plastic petals could ignite, resulting in melting and dripping plastic. The ignited plastic could also spread to nearby combustibles and pose a fire hazard to consumers. The battery contained in the middle of candle could eventually explo

title: CPSC, Applica Consumer Products Inc. Announce Recall of Black & Decker® Brand ProBlend® Blenders
summary: The blades can weaken or break during use, while making frozen beverages. A broken blade presents a risk of injury, if taken into the mouth or swallowed. Units: About 500,000.

title: CPSC, Bernat Yarn Announce Recall of "Fur Out" Yarn
summary: Fur Out yarn is flammable when used as the sole yarn in a garment. Garments constructed of "Fur Out" yarn are dangerously flammable when exposed to a flame, posing a burn risk to consumers. Units: About 730,000 1.75-ounce balls of yarn.

title: CPSC, CF Roark Welding & Engineering Announce Recall of Bicycle Frames
summary: The frames on these bicycles can crack and fail during use, posing a risk of injury to riders. Units: 422.

title: CPSC, Lithonia Lighting Announce Recall of Indoor HID Light Fixture Cords
summary: The cord of the light fixture can drip plasticizer fluid onto the light fixture, which can degrade the acrylic reflector, causing it to crack and fall. Falling pieces of acrylic can injure a person below the fixture. Units: About 120,000.

title: CPSC, Montrail Inc. Announce Recall of Crampons; Products Used for Ice Climbing and Mountaineering
summary: The vertical rails at the front of these crampons can break, which could result in falls and injuries to consumers. Units: 969 pairs.

title: CPSC, Delta Enterprise Corp. Announce Recall to Repair Portable Cribs
summary: The crib slats can separate from the headboard, posing an entrapment risk to young children. In addition, children can fall through the slat opening. Units: About 10,000.

title: CPSC, JVC Announce Recall to Repair Rear-Projection Televisions
summary: An internal electrical connection can cause electrical arcing, charring or smoking inside the television, which pose a fire risk to consumers. Units: 26,500.

title: CPSC, Shaw Industries Inc. Announce Recall of Carpet Sold at Menards Stores
summary: Due to a manufacturing error, an uneven application of a latex pre-coat treatment containing a flame retardant was applied to the carpet backing. As a result, the carpet does not meet flammability standards, as required under the federal Flammable Fabrics Act. The carpet could ignite, posing a serio

title: CPSC, Honeywell Sensing and Controls Announce Recall of Thermal Switches
summary: When these switches are used in fire or HVAC dampers and heat detectors, they could fail to operate, causing the damper not to close or causing the heat detector not to alarm, if there is a fire. Units: About 113,500, including about 12,200 that were installed in buildings.

title: CPSC, Lithonia Lighting Announce Recall of Indoor HID Light Fixtures
summary: A component in the light fixture can leak fluid, which can degrade the acrylic lenses and reflectors, causing them to crack and fall. Falling pieces of acrylic can injure someone below the fixture. Units: About 93,200.

title: CPSC, Mr. Heater, Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Mr. Heater "Big Buddy/Tough Buddy" Propane Heaters
summary: The valve on the propane heaters can leak, posing a fire hazard, if an ignition source is present. Units: About 55,000.

title: CPSC, TechnoBrands Inc. Announce Recall of Rope Candles
summary: The candle has a clamp that is used to extinguish the candle. The clamp does not always sever the wax close to the wick and extinguish the candle as intended. This can allow the flame to continue down into the coiled section of the candle and ignite the entire candle. Units: About 2,000.

title: CPSC, Bombardier Recreational Products Inc. and BRP US Inc. Announce Recall of DS650 ATVs
summary: The rear axle bearings may have not been sufficiently greased. This may cause a breaking of the bearing, which could make the ATV unstable. The operator could lose control of the vehicle, which could cause injury to the operator. Units: 2,127.

title: CPSC, Nature's Finest Announce Recall of Gel Candles
summary: The gel used in these candles can catch fire, creating a high flame. This can result in nearby combustibles catching fire and in burns to consumers. Units: About 727,000.

title: CPSC, Arctic Cat Inc. Announce Recall of All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs)
summary: The fuel tank used on some all-terrain vehicles could develop a fuel leak. If this occurs, a fire hazard, with the possibility of injury and property damage, could occur. Units: 16,200.

title: CPSC, MGA Entertainment Inc. Announce Recall of Bratz™ Stylin' Scooters™
summary: The wheels of the scooter can break or become damaged, and users of the scooters can fall and suffer injuries. Units: About 297,000.

title: CPSC, Reebok and Adjmi Announce Recall of Children's Reebok Jacket and Pant Sets
summary: The zipper slider and pull on the jackets can detach, if pulled when the jacket is open. The detached zipper slider and pull can pose a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 8,000.

title: CPSC, Whirlpool Announce Recall of KitchenAid® Toasters
summary: An interruption of power to the toaster can cause the heating elements to unexpectedly self-start and could ignite any flammable items left on top of the unit, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 40,000.

title: CPSC, Thomson Inc. Announce Recall of Portable DVD Player Batteries
summary: The battery can overheat and explode while recharging, posing a burn and fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 47,000 units.

title: CPSC, Graco Children's Products Announce Recall of Toddler Beds
summary: A child's arm, leg or foot can become entrapped between the slats in the guard rails or footboard. This can result in broken bones, sprains and other injuries to young children. Units: About 1.2 Million.

title: CPSC, Hellenic Rug Imports Announce Recall of Flammable Rugs
summary: Certain rugs distributed from January 2003 through February 2004 fail to meet the federal mandatory standard for flammability under the Flammable Fabrics Act. If the rugs ignite, they may not self-extinguish, presenting a risk of burn injuries. Units: About 1,600 rugs.
